name: 镇印刀盾卫
design: Broad square red lamellar infantry, huge rectangular seal shield and short heavy cleaver; disciplined planted stance
rule: 举方盾列阵，物理减伤22%；怕绕过盾面的法术。

name: 穿封投矛手
design: Imperial red tabard scout, long seal-tagged throwing spear and a quiver of folded spears, no shield
rule: 投矛撕开封甲，3.5秒内目标受到的物理伤害提高18%。

name: 压印重锤卫
design: Huge squat seal-press executioner, both hands on an oversized square stamp hammer, heavy rectangular shoulders
rule: 隔着前排落印重砸，范围打断；长前摇可被控制。

name: 落印攻城台
design: A low red rolling seal-printing press, broad square platen raised on two rails, NO generic cannon barrel
rule: 飞印优先拆城，命中短暂定身；低移速需要护送。

name: 督印旗官
design: Tall rectangular imperial banner, stern red-clad officer with a command baton and marching orders scroll
rule: 旗旁军队增伤18%，列阵集中有收益，也容易被范围攻击。

name: 护仓签盾兵
design: Short broad worker escort in layered red envelope armor, oversized ribbed signing-board tower shield, small baton
rule: 护仓而非追击，附近运金纸工受到伤害减少35%。

name: 朱印运金纸工
design: Disciplined red seal-office porter, boxy lacquer backpack, square stamp helmet, short iron pick.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 撕页猎骨者
design: Lean ragged violet bone-paper stalker, skull mask, two uneven torn-paper sickles and long hunched spine
rule: 短距扑击并吸血，靠活体冲阵；与纸骨召唤群互相掩护。

name: 腐墨骨针师
design: Tiny stooped old-paper witch with a long hollow bone blowpipe, fungus-filled ink pouch and ragged hood
rule: 骨针腐墨叠三层，净化和短时爆发能够反制。

name: 拾纸招魂祭司
design: Ragged violet skull-hood necromancer with crooked skull staff, torn scrolls and skeletal hands
rule: 消耗真实战斗残页招魂；没有遗骸时无法凭空出兵。

name: 缝骨纸骸兽
design: Asymmetric lumbering beast made of stitched old bone-paper scraps, hunched rib cage and massive unequal fists
rule: 慢速范围拳击，倒下散出骨片；怕被长距离拉扯。

name: 缠魂割纸客
design: Thin spectral paper reaper in a long perforated violet veil, hooked bone scythe and hanging soul strips
rule: 高吸血法术近战，生命低且难以摸到后排。

name: 墨缚钉魂者
design: Low spider-like paper shaman wrapped in black ink threads, a bundle of bone pins in both hands, no conventional armor
rule: 骨钉缚魂并封口，主要克制支援施法兵。

name: 旧墨运金纸工
design: Hunched ragged old-paper bone scavenger, skull hood, crooked bone pick and tied torn-paper basket.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 转灯映符卫
design: Turquoise lamp guardian with a round rotating bronze mirror, curling talismans and a folded ceremonial hat
rule: 圆镜反射纸质飞弹，直伤法术和近战不受影响。

name: 连签燃灯者
design: Teal-robed lantern handler with a long vertical paper lantern and two flame talisman strips between fingers
rule: 两连火签点燃，签纸补充期间脆弱。

name: 折影越阵客
design: Extremely low folded teal origami ninja, split triangular cape, two short paper daggers and talisman eye mask
rule: 折入敌阵跨过前排，专打支援兵；定身可阻断越阵。

name: 灯腹护符俑
design: Tall hollow turquoise paper shrine effigy with a glowing lantern in its belly and wide flat talisman arms
rule: 灯腹结界保护附近友军抵抗法术，怕物理攻城。

name: 折符纸匠
design: Small teal craftswoman carrying a tray of folded talisman dolls, sleeves folded into sharp triangles
rule: 现场折出最多两名有时限的护符纸卫。

name: 叠灯复影师
design: Tall ceremonial teal magician with three nested paper lamps and a folding fan of duplicate silhouettes
rule: 复制附近真实小型盟友，复制体有时限，巨兵不能复制。

name: 青符运金纸工
design: Small turquoise lantern porter, folded ceremonial hat, dangling lamp and talisman-labeled gold basket.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 发条铆甲拳兵
design: Compact brass-and-brown paper automaton, cylindrical spring torso, piston punch gauntlet, tiny squared head
rule: 连续第三次命中铆钉震击；稳定贴身才能完成连段。

name: 折簧钉枪手
design: Workshop mechanic with large folded nail-gun, exposed spring magazine, asymmetric leather apron and goggles
rule: 三轮钉枪后必须装填；持续压制与装填窗口均真实存在。

name: 旋齿修械匠
design: Short workshop engineer with giant articulated wrench, gear backpack and mismatched brass goggles
rule: 修理实际受损设施，离开施工与前哨阵地便失去价值。

name: 折簧重弩车
design: A wide low wheeled spring ballista with a folding paper bow, visible winch and a single large gear, NO cannon
rule: 绞盘展开后射重弩拆城，每发回卷装填。

name: 解构折雷机
design: Walking round folded brass mine with little mechanical feet, an engineer seat and a demolition probe
rule: 对未完成建筑拆解增伤，并使非基地设施短暂停机。

name: 齿盾维修偶
design: Bulky squat paper robot with a circular rotating gear shield and drill hand, broad barrel waist
rule: 驻在己方设施旁攻击提高35%，离开阵地缺乏机动。

name: 铜折运金纸工
design: Brass workshop mining automaton with telescopic legs, a geared pick and cylindrical ore backpack.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 纸翼突枪客
design: Slim blue feather-paper courier with huge folded kite wings and a forward long lance, no heavy shield
rule: 实际移动积攒冲势，下一枪增伤；定身与拥堵会破坏节奏。

name: 回风游弓手
design: Blue bird-hood archer, long curved feather bow, flowing split-tail cape and light sandal feet
rule: 射箭后沿当前道路后撤，近身与封路可以抓住。

name: 牵线钩翼兵
design: Winged blue rope runner with a long hooked kite line, feather headpiece and an extremely stretched low stance
rule: 钩线牵近同路目标并缓行，改变真实站位。

name: 风筝投弹架
design: A light blue twin-wing kite launcher on three thin legs and tiny wheels, hanging folded diamond bomb packets
rule: 分次送出三枚风筝弹包，轻巧但没有传统炮车护甲。

name: 长尾纸骑
design: A blue courier riding a long-tail angular folded paper horse, long thin jousting pole and streaming wing ribbons
rule: 过路口加速截击快速单位，长距离增援更有优势。

name: 顺风递纸车
design: A delicate blue sail-assisted two-wheel messenger cart, open letter satchels and feather vanes, no weapon barrel
rule: 顺风旗给附近作战部队加速，脆弱的运输支援。

name: 雁羽运金纸工
design: Light blue kite-wing messenger miner, feather hood and long letter satchel, a delicate hooked pick.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 守契雇佣卫
design: Stocky gold-contract mercenary, round coin shield, quilted bill armor, coin-plated short blade and mustache
rule: 保留金库提高伤害，上限24%；存钱与增兵形成取舍。

name: 掷契金签客
design: Gold trader with wide-brim ledger hat, brass coin pouch and a fan of rectangular throwing contract tokens
rule: 双投契签，击杀真实敌兵收取赏金；不奖励召唤物。

name: 断契追债镰
design: Tall gold debt collector, enormous crescent contract-cutting scythe, long black-gold cape and ledger belt
rule: 长镰隔前排收割残血赚赏金；满血重甲能扛第一轮。

name: 金库撞票车
design: Huge armored rolling golden strongbox, a long horizontal stamping ram, bill scrolls coiled around its wheels
rule: 近身撞城而非远程炮击，票甲能扛物理却怕控制。

name: 护票押运司
design: A golden walking banker with tall sealed ledger backpack, long rolled payment scroll and umbrella-like coin shield
rule: 护送附近纸工每次归仓多得2金，必须实际往返才能赚取。

name: 悬赏契弩客
design: Lanky gold bounty hunter behind an oversized heavy contract crossbow, a rolled wanted poster tied to the stock
rule: 慢速重弩优先支援单位，长装填使近战突击有效。

name: 金契运金纸工
design: Gold-contract merchant porter with fat ledger sack, round coin-trimmed cap and a wide coin shovel.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 根藤护仓卫
design: A small living wooden fiber stump with root feet, a huge layered leaf shield and vine tendril arm, not a human recolor
rule: 根藤护仓并自愈，阻断自然修复的腐墨是克星。

name: 孢籽吹叶灵
design: Tiny mushroom-headed forest paper sprite with leaf ears, seed-pod blowpipe and a round spore backpack
rule: 三颗命中同一敌人的孢籽长出缠根，带持续腐蚀。

name: 花冠补叶师
design: Flower-crowned gentle paper gardener, huge blossom staff, leaf-layered skirt and a medicine basket
rule: 补叶同时清除腐墨与燃烧，需保护脆弱的花冠师。

name: 盘根古纸树
design: An enormous angular living tree made of layered green fiber paper, branch horns, root legs, both arms are thick knotty wood
rule: 树根重砸短暂缠住敌群，缓慢推进，需要治疗配合。

name: 织藤结网者
design: Long thin praying-mantis-like leaf spirit, four folded vine limbs and a woven seed web held between hands
rule: 远程织藤固定敌人，定身不禁止对方攻击。

name: 返叶萤蛾
design: A large luminous green leaf moth with broad veined paper wings, hanging pollen sac and curled antennae, no humanoid soldier
rule: 萤蛾阵亡散出补叶粉治疗附近盟友，治疗不会产生伤害。

name: 活纤运金纸工
design: Tiny living leaf-and-mushroom gardener, root feet, seed basket and wooden leaf-shaped digging tool.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 规尺雪盾卫
design: Square ice-blue paper bailiff, huge caliper-shaped shield, geometric snow helmet and straight ruler blade
rule: 扛物理并对近战反震，远程攻击不会触发反震。

name: 霜楔掷裁者
design: White-blue folded-paper judge, long triangular frost wedges instead of spears, severe tall angular hood
rule: 三枚霜楔命中同一敌人冻结，成功控制才获得法力。

name: 钉页定身司
design: Tall snow-white archivist with a giant stapling staff and a hanging book spine, long folded coat
rule: 近身钉页定身，适合把目标留给抛雪车。

name: 压雪折页车
design: Low blue-white mechanical stapler sled with a concave snow scoop and thick folded paper runners, not a generic cannon cart
rule: 高弧雪页对被控制目标增伤45%，慢出手可被突袭。

name: 冻墨封言吏
design: Tiny ice-blue calligrapher with oversized frost ruler and a dry frozen ink brush, square hanging book sleeves
rule: 冻墨封言并缓行，主要克制主动支援能力。

name: 寒页裁决官
design: Tall faceless snow-paper tribunal spirit, floating open law book and long geometric ice-page staff
rule: 寒页裁决跳向第二个敌人，密集阵型更易受控。

name: 霜裁运金纸工
design: White-blue archival worker, ruler-shaped pick, rigid rectangular ore box and snow-paper hood.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 半燃双刃徒
design: Bare-armed charcoal-paper exile with scorched jagged hair, two uneven ember blades and torn glowing cloth, not armored infantry
rule: 残血双刃加伤，抢先爆发或控制能阻止反扑。

name: 炭弓余火猎
design: Hooded orange ash-paper hunter, charred asymmetrical branch bow and ember-tipped arrows, long torn scarf
rule: 炭弓命中持续燃烧，净化与压近可以反制。

name: 取火钩魂客
design: Charcoal-masked slim exile, a long hooked fire-curved blade and a small furnace carried at the waist
rule: 只从已燃烧目标吸血，需要余火猎和喷签师铺火。

name: 陶灰投火炉
design: A squat orange clay-paper kiln on broad scorched wheels, a rear chimney and hinged bowl catapult, no cannon barrel
rule: 投出余火壶点燃敌群，炉车前摇长且容易被绕后。

name: 灰风喷签师
design: Hunched charcoal-paper bellows operator with a giant folded leather bellows, soot mask and burning talisman hopper
rule: 近程三段灰风扫群，火线短，需要前排保住喷签口。

name: 裂火抱壶者
design: A frantic small ash-paper exile hugging a huge cracked glowing fire pot, stubby bare feet and scorched headband
rule: 抱壶突入，阵亡引爆敌方；不会误伤己方纸工。

name: 余烬运金纸工
design: Ash-paper miner in charcoal mask with a soot-black pick, patched pot backpack and torn orange wrap.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 空框映界卫
design: An eerie ivory faceless guard with an empty rectangular frame shield, a hole cut through the torso and thin violet seams
rule: 每5秒抹去一次敌方法术伤害，物理攻击穿透空框。

name: 镂字连签弩
design: White masked scribe with a punched-letter mechanical crossbow, floating cutout letters and a long perforated coat
rule: 首发删去敌人护符与强化再三连击，自己非常怕近战。

name: 删行执笔人
design: Very tall faceless ivory paper editor, huge thin eraser-quill staff and a rectangular blank page instead of face
rule: 删行法术封口，击杀真实敌兵返法，无法从召唤物刷取。

name: 页界折兽
design: Enormous horizontal ivory origami fox-dragon, four angular folded legs, long blank paper muzzle and layered fan tail; NOT humanoid golem
rule: 折兽展开页界喷息，抗法术却怕物理围攻。

name: 留白消矢师
design: Floating ivory folded-book spirit inside a white circular paper aperture, small faceless head and a fan eraser
rule: 周期抹除附近敌方飞弹，不消除直伤法术，沉默可封住。

name: 覆写禁印官
design: Ivory archivist carrying an oversized delete-stamp cylinder and a black-violet narrow ledger, rigid vertical long coat
rule: 覆写印优先封锁支援兵，逼对方用前排掩护。

name: 留白运金纸工
design: Small faceless ivory folded-paper clerk with a rectangular empty-frame basket and a narrow erase-pick.
rule: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

name: 纸骨兵
design: A very small ragged old-paper skeleton with bone limbs and a broken blade, empty skull face and no cloth armor.
rule: 有来源与寿命限制的召唤物，不能招募或复制。

name: 护符纸卫
design: A small turquoise folded talisman doll with a squared lamp belly, short arms, tiny paper spear and faceless blank mask.
rule: 有来源与寿命限制的召唤物，不能招募或复制。
